pages.text: "The ice boat!" Bung hopped up, gripping the edge. Their tied noodle boat floated still. Ddori pointed at the ice boat in the waterway's middle.
"Mom, I want ice. Can I call it here?" "Call, and it comes." Mom gave Bung money. Bung's heart fluttered.
The ice boat came nearer. But Bung's mouth would not open. Behind Mom, Bung clutched the awning.
The boat glided past, leaving waves. "Too shy to call..." Bung held the money tight, head down.
Mom sat close. "Try very quietly first. Just to me." Into her ear, Bung whispered, "Ice..."
"Now your hand too." Mom raised Bung's wrist high. Ddori copied with a little hand. "Hand up, one word! That is all."
Soon another ice boat came. Bung took a deep breath, raised a hand, and called, "Ice!"
The seller nodded and paddled over. Two cold pieces landed in Bung's hands. Bung's cheeks turned pink.
Bung drew Ddori's hand close and shared. "One, a big breath! Two, hand up! Three, just one word! Next, I will call the fruit boat too!"
Mom hugged Bung close. "Only one word needed!" Ddori nibbled ice. "Ah!" Bung crunched a bite. "Hand up, one word!"
